integrity: Proof and exact-rational standalone verification are supplied. The proof explicitly attributes the infinite-mode strict diagonal ordering to its primary source. Computational checks do not substitute for this theorem.
scientific_limitations: Dimension d=3 and mixed radial-angular exponent q=4 only. Assumes Xu (2026) strict diagonal Bessel-moment ordering as a published result; independent audit not performed. The ordinary L4 extension norm and other dimensions are not treated. Earlier unindexed equivalent conditional inequalities remain a literature risk.
title: Sharp conditional fourth-power profile for spherical mixed Fourier extension
